gwt.given: An OrleansDbQueryDefinitions value has constructor-supplied grain type 'orders' and no QueryProcedure or Lazy<QueryStatement> for its write role (only its read and clear roles are supplied).
gwt.then: The access throws OrleansQueryNotProvidedException whose message is "The Orleans Grain “orders” does not have a query defined for its WriteQuery method." — naming WriteQuery specifically, not ReadQuery or ClearQuery, because the accessor property name is captured via [CallerMemberName].
